narrNote: NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched in-run, HTTP 200) states verbatim for Kansas: "There's no NARR affiliate in this state." No Kansas affiliate is listed, so narrAffiliate is null per doctrine — no substitute organization is presented as a NARR affiliate.
notes: KDADS Behavioral Health Services is Kansas's current SAMHSA Single State Agency function (an older SAMHSA-era listing naming Social and Rehabilitation Services is outdated). kdads.ks.gov and kancare.ks.gov block plain curl requests (HTTP 403 bot protection); both were verified in-run via a text page fetch returning the correct site content ('Department for Aging and Disability Services | Home'; 'KanCare | Home'). Agency phone is null: the number 785-296-4986 appears in secondary sources but was not confirmed on kdads.ks.gov itself in-run, so it is not published here. 211kansas.org resolves (clean redirect) to the live 211 Kansas resource database operated by United Way of the Plains. The Kansas Consumer Advisory Council is Kansas's statewide peer/consumer-run organization (entirely people in recovery; coordinates the annual Kansas Recovery Conference). The KDADS KCPM page documents the state SUD peer-mentor certification. Every URL in this file was fetched on 2026-10-22 and returned HTTP 200 (or a clean redirect) with matching content. Read-only public research only: no logins, no credentials, no form submissions, no downloads.
